claims.text: The hotel sits at the edge of the Chateau de Versailles gardens and has occupied its site since 1910.

findings.quote: Just at the edge of the Chateau de Versailles gardens, the Trianon Palace has occupied a prime piece of real estate since 1910.

claims.text: The architecture takes its inspiration from the Grand Trianon at Versailles.

findings.quote: The architecture takes its inspiration from the Grand Trianon, the pink-marble hideaway built by the Louis XIV as an escape from confining courtly life.

claims.text: The Trianon Palace building features neoclassical architecture and a grand gallery filled with daylight.

findings.quote: The Trianon Palace is a 5 star venue featuring majestic neoclassical architecture and opulent décor. Discover our grand gallery filled with daylight

claims.text: The hotel has two sections, Trianon Palace and Pavillon du Trianon.

findings.quote: guests will have the choice of two sections, Trianon Palace and Pavillon du Trianon

claims.text: Most Pavillon du Trianon rooms overlook the hotel's gardens.

findings.quote: The Pavillon is a 4 star building accommodating 99 rooms, most of which overlook the hotel’s stunning gardens.

claims.text: Palace suites have a separate living area and views of the Chateau and its Royal Domain.

findings.quote: Experience unrivalled luxury in our collection of five-star suites. Relax with a separate living area and views of the Chateau and its Royal Domain.

claims.text: Rooms have mosaic-tiled marble bathrooms with heated floors.

findings.quote: Rooms come with Nespresso machines, Salvatore Ferragamo bath products, and mosaic-tiled marble bathrooms with heated floors.

claims.text: La Véranda brasserie serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with continental cuisine.

findings.quote: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, La Véranda brasserie offers exquisite continental cuisine

claims.text: Peacock Alley serves afternoon tea and a wide selection of wines.

findings.quote: Enjoy afternoon tea, a wide selection of wines, plus a warm and relaxing atmosphere at Peacock Alley.

claims.text: The hotel's culinary duo is Executive Chef Frédéric Larquemin and Pastry Chef Eddie Benghanem.

findings.quote: Learn more about Executive Chef Frédéric Larquemin and Pastry Chef Eddie Benghanem, our unique duo at Waldorf Astoria Versailles.

claims.text: There is a kids club for younger guests.

claims.text: Guests can walk directly from the hotel into the Chateau de Versailles gardens.

findings.quote: Walking directly into the Chateau de Versailles gardens from the hotel.
